newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur to cut loan rate by 0.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur to cut loan rate by 0.25 pct.

text.p: Morocco's leading Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur will cut loan interest rates by 0.25 percent, effective February 1st, a bank spokesman said on Friday.
"To set up an example, the BMCE will reduce its interest rate by quarter a point on future loans to enterprises and development projects," the spokesman told Reuters.
The interest rate reduction will help promote foreign and domestic investments in Morocco, create jobs and boost economic growth, the spokesman said.
The interest rate on short-term loans will be reduced to 9.50 percent from 9.75 percent, he said but declined to give other details.
